name: Mei Fong Tan
bio:
Mei Fong Tan's journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly during a university internship at a local tech firm contracted to provide data analysis for a regional racing team. Intrigued by the complexities of performance optimization, she quickly immersed herself in the intricacies of race data and IT infrastructure. Over the years, Mei Fong has developed a reputation for her meticulous approach to systems management, ensuring seamless data flow and robust cybersecurity for Hot Car Competições. 

Her focus extends beyond mere maintenance; Mei Fong emphasizes proactive solutions, always seeking innovative ways to leverage technology for competitive advantage. She believes in empowering her team through knowledge sharing and mentorship, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the IT department. Mei Fong's calm demeanor and analytical mind make her a reliable asset in the high-pressure environment of motorsport, earning the respect of her colleagues and competitors alike.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a short, layered bob with subtle waves.
physical.description: Mei Fong is of average height with a thoughtful expression and kind eyes that reflect her years of experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with IT solutions and racing anecdotes.
Insists on using a vintage mechanical keyboard, claiming it provides superior tactile feedback.
Starts every team meeting with a tech-related riddle or puzzle to encourage critical thinking.
